title: Veterans Pension Net Worth Redetermination Worksheet
content:
# Worksheet — redetermined net worth on a Veterans Pension award

**Clause.** The redetermined net worth is the assets last determined, plus what has been deposited since the award was granted, less VA home loans, plus annual income, rounded to the cent, where:

1. **Assets last determined** are the net worth on the award less the income on the reports it was determined from — the most recent figure for each of the veteran's Social Security, the spouse's Social Security, his federal civil service annuity and interest and dividends (nothing for a source with no report) — and less every compensation release posted to it since the award was granted, at its gross amount.
2. **Deposits since the grant.** Every compensation release deposited since the award was granted adds the net amount that reached the veteran's account, and every home loan funding fee VA refunded to him since then adds the amount refunded, because that money is now his to hold.
3. **VA home loans.** The unpaid principal balance of every VA Home Loan Guaranty loan the veteran holds is subtracted.
4. **Annual income** is the countable income on the award plus the one-time payments the veteran declared; no one-time payment is added. Annual income is used whole.
5. **Medical figures.** The medical threshold is the rate category's medical expense threshold percentage of the category's basic rate for the medical deduction, rounded to the cent. Insurance premiums add nothing; the care cost is the monthly care figure — the total of the care months reported in the 3 whole months before the redetermination — counted once, rounded to the cent.

"Since the award was granted" runs from the date the award was opened.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| Net worth on the award | 62000.00 |
| less income on its reports (Social Security 14000.00, interest 500.00) | 14500.00 |
| less compensation release posted at gross | 10000.00 |
| Assets last determined | 37500.00 |
| plus net amount of that release that reached the account | 9200.00 |
| plus funding fee refunded | 0.00 |
| less unpaid principal balance of the VA home loan | 30000.00 |
| plus annual income (countable income on the award, used whole) | 15000.00 |
| Redetermined net worth | 31700.00 |
